exposure: Vaginal Natural Orifice Transluminal Endoscopic Surgery (vNOTES)
cohort: The study included 15 patients between 20 and 80 years of age with histologically proven Stage 1 Grade 1-2 endometrial cancer.
finding: The study found that vNOTES surgical staging for early-stage endometrial cancer is feasible and practical with minimal complications.
